Name: Any Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Any Phase)
Effect: BIOLOGICAL STRUCTURE: PASSIVE
This Unit cannot gain the BURROWED Status , cannot
be returned to Reserves , and is immune to the
IMPACT keyword.
DETECTION: PASSIVE While Enemy Units are Within 6" of
this Unit, they lose the HIDDEN Status .
SOURCE OF CREEP: PASSIVE A Friendly or Enemy Ground
Zerg Unit Within 6" of this Unit counts as being ON CREEP .

Name: Movement Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Movement Phase)
Effect: BURROW AMBUSH: PASSIVE When this Unit is nominated to deploy from the
Reserves , it may resolve the PLACE (18) effect from the controlling player's Entry Edge . No model may be set
Within 10" of any Enemy model. This Unit's Activation ends.
BOMBARD: ACTIVE 1 BM Set a Bile Bomb token on the battlefield Within 24" of this Unit. When this Unit
resolves a Ranged Attack using the Bile Bomb weapon profile this Round , it may choose to ignore the weapon's
standard Range characteristic. If it does, it may target an Enemy Unit that is Within 3" of that token ( Line of
Sight is not required), ignoring the HIDDEN Status . After the attack is fully resolved, remove the Bile Bomb token
from the battlefield. When the Bile Bomb token is about to be removed, set a Creep Tumor token in base-to-base
contact with it. The Bile Bomb token has DISPLACEMENT .

Name: Assault Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Assault Phase)
Effect: INDOMITABLE: PASSIVE While Engaged , this Unit may target and be targeted by Unengaged Enemy Units. In
both cases, the defending Unit gains an Evade Roll against those attacks.

Name: Any Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Any Phase)
Effect: BURROW: ACTIVE 2 BM If this Unit is Unengaged , it gains or loses the Burrowed Status .

Name: Movement Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Movement Phase)
Effect: ROACHLING INFESTATION: ACTIVE 2 BM Once Per Game . Resolve the SUMMON
(Roachling) effect.

Name: Assault Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Assault Phase)
Effect: REGENERATION: PASSIVE When this Unit becomes
Activated , if it has the Burrowed Status , resolve the
HEAL (2) effect.
DEVASTATING CHARGE: PASSIVE Immediately after
this Unit completes a successful Charge , resolve the
IMPACT (3) 4+ effect.

Name: Any Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Any Phase)
Effect: CONSUME: PASSIVE When this Unit resolves a Special Ability that costs BM , it can remove one model

Description:

Name: Assault Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Assault Phase)
Effect: DARK SWARM: REACTION 1 BM REPEATABLE . Use when a Friendly Unit Within 4" of
a Friendly Dark Swarm token is selected as the target of an attack. If this Unit is Within 4'' of the same token,
the Targeted Friendly Unit is eligible to make an Evade Roll against that attack. If the targeted Unit is a Size 1 ,
it gains a +1 Modifier to this Evade Roll .
DEVASTATING CHARGE: PASSIVE Immediately after this Unit completes a successful Charge , resolve the IMPACT
(4) 4+ effect.

attack is fully resolved, this Unit, if Unengaged , may perform a Move action Directly Towards the attacking Unit.

STRUCTURE: PASSIVE This Unit cannot be Activated in
any Phase and cannot perform actions. Additionally, its
Current Supply Value is treated as 0 , and it can never
Control or Contest Mission Markers , ignoring the standard
Zero Supply Exception . This Unit cannot be a target of an
ability, unless stated otherwise.
OMEGA NETWORK: PASSIVE The base of the Omega
Worm counts as an Entry Edge . Each Round, Friendly Units
with a combined Supply cost of 2 or less may be Deployed
via this Entry Edge .
If a Friendly Leading model finishes a Move, Disengage , or
Run action in base-to-base contact with the Omega Worm ,
the controlling player may remove that Unit from the
battlefield and return it to Reserves .

RESTORATION: REACTION 1 BM Use when a Friendly Unit

at least 7 Friendly models Within 6" of this Unit, it may
resolve its Special Ability with the BM cost reduced by 1 .
